en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Traditional village song, no author known (origin unclear). 'ваке-таке' left as a refrain; 'ситноно писмо' is my reading as a carefully written letter.

lines.cyr: Ми се собрале, ваке-таке, ми се набрале
lines.lat: Mi se sobrale, vake-take, mi se nabrale
lines.en: They gathered, vake-take, they came together

lines.cyr: Лаф ми правеле, ваке-таке, лаф ми чинеле
lines.lat: Laf mi pravele, vake-take, laf mi činele
lines.en: They held a talk, vake-take, they had a chat
in the middle of the village, under the little walnut tree.
They spoke up, vake-take, Dimo Stankoski

lines.cyr: - Да го викнеме, ваке-таке, попа Јована
lines.lat: - Da go vikneme, vake-take, popa Jovana
lines.en: - Let us call, vake-take, Father Jovan the priest
to write us a fine-lettered letter.

lines.cyr: Да го пратиме, ваке-таке, до град Битола,
lines.lat: Da go pratime, vake-take, do grad Bitola,
lines.en: Let us send it, vake-take, to the city of Bitola,
to the city of Bitola, to the governor.

lines.cyr: Да нѝ ја пушти, ваке-таке, силнана војска
lines.lat: Da nì ja pušti, vake-take, silnana vojska
lines.en: Let him send us, vake-take, a strong army

lines.cyr: да нѝ го чува нашево село.
lines.lat: da nì go čuva naševo selo.
lines.en: to guard this village of ours.

lines.cyr: Да нѝ го чува, ваке-таке, нашево село,
lines.lat: Da nì go čuva, vake-take, naševo selo,
lines.en: To guard it for us, vake-take, this village of ours,

lines.cyr: Не се живее, ваке-таке, од качаците,
lines.lat: Ne se živee, vake-take, od kačacite,
lines.en: We cannot live, vake-take, because of the outlaws,
because of the outlaws, Mecha the outlaw,
